name: saxpy
summary: y[i] = alpha * x[i] + y_in[i] over n f32 elements; alpha is a one-element f32 input
provenance: authored for OpenAccel Lab (Apache-2.0); BLAS level-1 SAXPY semantics

y.why: alpha*x+y is a length-2 dot product (alpha,1).(x,y): unfused it is two roundings, fused one, so |err| <= gamma(2)*(|alpha x|+|y|) (Higham Thm 3.1); reference.py passes |alpha x|+|y| as scale. WolframLanguageEvaluator: g[n_]:=n 2^-24/(1-n 2^-24); N[g[2],6] -> 1.19209*10^-7
